description: This file contains a test runner class for Orleans transaction tests using xUnit. It extends a base test runner and overrides test methods to run specific transaction-related tests with different grain states.

classes.name: GrainFaultTransactionTestRunnerxUnit
classes.description: A test runner class for Orleans transaction tests using xUnit, extending the base GrainFaultTransactionTestRunner class.

methods.name: AbortTransactionOnExceptions
methods.description: Overrides the base method to run transaction abort tests on exceptions with different grain states.

methods.name: AbortTransactionOnReadOnlyViolatedException
methods.description: Overrides the base method to test abort on read-only violations.

methods.name: MultiGrainAbortTransactionOnExceptions
methods.description: Overrides the base method to test multi-grain abort scenarios on exceptions.

methods.name: AbortTransactionExceptionInnerExceptionOnlyContainsOneRootCauseException
methods.description: Overrides the base method to verify exception inner exception contains only one root cause.

methods.name: AbortTransactionOnOrphanCalls
methods.description: Overrides the base method to test abort behavior on orphan calls.
